capabilities: close the current tab or empty window via command or hotkey
cycle through tab groups and popouts until one tab remains
unpin or close pinned tabs via a setting
close the window from the last tab's close button or middle click
hide the app instead of closing the last window on macOS
extras: Does not take over cmd+W by itself; the user must remove the core "Close current tab" hotkey and assign it to this plugin's command. The hide-instead-of-close option is macOS only.
intentEvidence: provides an alternative to the "Close current tab" command in Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's built-in "Close current tab" leaves the last tab open or the window empty, unlike browser-like closing behavior.
summary: Command that closes the current tab and, when the last tab is closed, closes the window instead of leaving it empty.
